automationContract.note: A successful controller edit reports generation 2 and advances the editor service generation to 2. The following invalid edit therefore uses expectedGeneration 2 so it reaches semantic validation instead of failing as stale.

knownGateLimitations: The phase-gate schema cannot create a controller or attach a cooked controller to the imported prefab.
The phase-gate schema cannot assert runtime transition state, blend weight, pose, event, or root-motion values from an AnimationGraphInstance.
The invalid controller edit is intentionally expected to fail; preservation is proved only by before/after asset inspection and validation receipts.

Each manual checklist item accepts one human action request after the described workflow and captures one gate-owned native screenshot at that time; it does not provide evidence for every individual click or keystroke.
